The players first need an empty barrel, which spawn in the Tyras Camp, reachable by taking a charter ship to Port Tyras, and in the orchard south of the Tree Gnome Stronghold and west of Combat Training Camp. The players may want multiple if they fail and do not want to return to refill the barrels. The players then need to fill the barrels with tar, which they can fill it on the swamp directly south of the Tirannwn lodestone, giving a barrel of coal-tar.
The players are required to distil the tar into naphtha, for which they should bring 10 pieces of coal to the large fractionation still outside of the Chemist's House in Rimmington. The players may not succeed, but it is easier to mess up the pressure part than the heat part – so they should not need more than 10 pieces of coal. The players may also need to refill the still with coal-tar. The players can either bring multiple barrels or take the same empty barrel back to the tar swamp as it is only a short distance from the lodestone.
